name: statushired-mern
description: StatusHired - job application tracker (MERN: MongoDB, Express, React, Node)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e
